prompt: Create a loan screening workflow for a financial institution. When a loan application is received, validate the data and enrich with credit information. Route applications based on loan amount—standard loans go through regular screening, while large loans (>$250k) require enhanced screening. All applications need risk assessment and compliance checks. If compliance issues are found, request additional documentation. Every application must be reviewed by an underwriter before final decision. Log everything for regulatory audit.
